body:
Verified local refactor pushed at `8a44c6b1fc8a7d580de82412ab821e46c07c5d76`.

[Design and diagrams](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/blob/8a44c6b1fc8a7d580de82412ab821e46c07c5d76/docs/BRO_ORCHESTRATOR_REFACTOR_IMPLEMENTATION.md), [RF01–RF12 / A01–A22 acceptance](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/blob/8a44c6b1fc8a7d580de82412ab821e46c07c5d76/docs/evidence/bro-goal-workflow/2026-10-16-refactor-acceptance.md), [source-bound summary](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/blob/8a44c6b1fc8a7d580de82412ab821e46c07c5d76/docs/evidence/bro-goal-workflow/2026-10-16-refactor-summary.json).

Full current-source `fixture-image-final123`: **4,757 tests passed, 24 skipped, zero reported LEAKs and no source drift**, with two outer test slots and internal workflow concurrency intact. Three repeated mock-ACP batches, four actual Goal PTY cases, two typed startup guards, a focused native parallel workflow, native/ACP feature isolation, ACP-free native dependency tree, Rust1.93, strict all-target/all-feature Clippy, fmt, six doctests (one ignored), and generated-artifact checks passed. Executable, test and CI inputs match the accepted source; final publication changes metadata only.

The native parallel fixture now waits separately for upstream handoffs, dependent join handoff and root acceptance: three45s waits (135s aggregate versus90s previously). This explicitly increases fixture allowance; overlap, isolation, checked-dependency and delivery assertions and product budgets remain. Linux jobs collect all failures without new retries. Cargo-built Rust fixtures run immutable byte-verified images with serialized atomic publication. A bounded post-check observed no image-path gaps or OS spawn errors during160 Cargo refreshes; protocol behavior is qualified separately by the actual tests. Original ENOENT causality remains inferred, and original failed/incomplete runs remain archived.

[Independent complete archive](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/tree/c0b75b141b3041a1cd9c1284aa16acc27caaab79): 4302 original files / 95933560 bytes; 1463 published files independently extracted and checksum-verified. SHA256SUMS digest: `f1a6e8dcde192cc5732f2b41ca74c2872f09b8afa6bce16806a0c10c542050dc`. It preserves original failures and incomplete runs, exact source maps/tars, configurations/runners, local fixture files/states and recovery bundles. Hosted failing filesystems were not exported. The [pre-refactor archive](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/tree/382c2b58c5c25b02805175a33d60707dc4227b46) remains pinned separately.

Actual vendor harness/provider requalification on this source is **unpassed**. ACP original-session continuation is limited to confirmed pre-prompt journals after actual source shutdown/join; unknown effects, possibly submitted prompts and missing private history remain blocked. Future core persistence, complete Turn-fixed model/context routing, dynamic graph edits, subgoals and Goal owner handoff remain deferred.

Hosted CI at exact head `8a44c6b1fc8a7d580de82412ab821e46c07c5d76`: **all 36 configured checks completed with success/neutral/skipped conclusions**. [CI](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/actions/runs/38988037552), [PR](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/actions/runs/38988126305), [Release](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/actions/runs/38988037401), [Package](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/actions/runs/38988037446), [PR](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/actions/runs/38988037431), [PR #981](https://github.com/bitrouter/bitrouter/actions/runs/38988035282). All 36 Linux app integration targets are selected exactly once, including native-goals with zero retries. Raw per-job logs and original test summaries are retained. Hosted output-leak markers: none. Hosted retry markers: none. These configured hosted outcomes remain separate from the strict zero-LEAK local qualification. Feature documents pin the local archive at `a5b49254addd8d75e61ac915b6a3e9f69a23258e`; this comment pins the later CI-inclusive archive at `c0b75b141b3041a1cd9c1284aa16acc27caaab79`. No merge performed.
